title: Relationship
description: A registered parent<->child link between two independent Codex tasks. Identity is the pair of actual task ids scoped by issue key; hostId is carried for routing and audit but is deliberately outside the hash because thread ids are already globally unique. Semantic invariant a validator must also enforce, because JSON Schema cannot: executionGeneration must appear in generations[].

relationshipId.description: rel- + first 16 hex of sha256(parentTaskId|childTaskId|issueKey). Deterministic so re-registration after an uncertain response is idempotent.

status.description: paused, cancelled and archived are never auto-resumed by the delivery loop.

executionGeneration.description: Pointer to the current entry in generations[]. A receipt naming an older generation is stale; one naming an absent generation is unknown_generation.

generations.description: Every generation ever opened, retained so historical anchors are never overwritten.

dispatchRequestId.description: The transport request id that authorized this generation. A replay of the same request id must not open a new generation.

anchorState.description: anchor_pending never auto-binds; it stays pending and reportable until an exact dispatch turn id is supplied.

dispatchTurnId.description: The exact child turn id from that dispatch receipt, or recovered by re-reading the same operation. Never inferred from whichever child turn appears next after registration.

authorizedScope.description: The scope this registration authorizes. A delivery naming a recipient outside allowedRecipients, or a manifest path outside artifactRoots, is refused before any transport call. This binds allowed paths and recipients; it is not a general authorization framework.

artifactRoots.description: Absolute directory prefixes. Every completion-receipt manifest path must lie under one of these.

allowedRecipients.description: Task ids this relationship may deliver to. Normally just the parent.

scopeRef.description: Optional pointer to the record that authorized this scope, for audit.
